estimates.rationale: Foundation feature establishing stock schema, core CRUD API endpoints (create, list), and full-stack UI (form with validation, list/detail view). Sets architectural baseline for all downstream features.
Incremental on FP1; adds single in-place update endpoint (PATCH) and optimistic frontend refresh. Reuses existing schema and no new domain concepts required.
Introduces new inbound receipt domain object; requires new schema (supplier, receipt tracking), create endpoint with stock-update logic, and receipt form UI.
Introduces new outbound pick domain object with write-time no-overcommit validation; requires pick schema, create endpoint with validation logic, and pick form with rejection feedback UI.
Adds SKU detail aggregation view showing all locations holding one SKU; requires new API query route and detail view UI, no new schema or domain objects required.
